name: Women's Class A coat general officer layer: as the officer layer with 1 1/2 in sleeve braid (overlay, blank grade)
size_basis: Sleeve braid width 1.5 in and 3 in from the sleeve end per CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2 / 4.1.9.2; epaulet width and length estimated from DAFI 36-2903 Figs 4.6-4.7 and the cadet board strips; US insignia size estimated. Braid tone: sampled from CAPR 39-1 (3 Mar 2020) rendered at 3x, Fig 4.6 PDF p64 (p.36) braid 2.3,33.1,86.2 / 2.7,31.9,84.3; Fig 4.1 PDF p54 (p.26) 2.1,32.3,83.6; Fig 4.7a PDF p73 (p.45) 2.1,32.4,84.6 against coat 0,40,101 (the figures draw a tonal braid, ~0.72x the coat luminance); drawn in the figure's line structure, 0.04 in lines on a 0.1 in pitch, but lighter than the figure: the tonal band repeats C/Col Doran's "too close to the jacket colour" (mess dress braid #0b1f5e, 1.1x the coat luminance, 2026-10-12) and the flat #2149a0 (5.3x) was "too light" (2026-10-14), so lines #1e3c82 (3.6x), gaps #12286a (1.9x), edge #0a1740 on the coat #001c52, band mean 2.5x, the geometric mean of the two rated values.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box
documented: general officers wear 1 1/2 in blue sleeve braid, 3 in from the end of the sleeve (CAPR 39-1 4.1.5.2 / 4.1.9.2)
assumed: braid colour: no shade specified for the Class A coat; the figures 4.6 / 4.7a draw it tonal, lightened to sit between the two tones C/Col Doran rated too close and too light (see base-art/braid-art.js)
rank insignia not drawn: placed by the rank insignia assets at rank_slot
